# Architecture Decision Records (ADRs)

This folder is **generated on demand** — it is empty in a fresh Dev-Kit clone.

## When files appear here

| Trigger | Skill | Output pattern |
|---------|-------|----------------|
| "Registra essa decisão" / "Write an ADR" | `adr-generator` | `ADR-{NNN}-{slug}.md` |

## What to expect

Each ADR captures a permanent architectural decision: context, options considered, decision, and consequences.

Quick decisions that do not warrant a full ADR can go in [`.github/memory/DECISIONS.md`](../../memory/DECISIONS.md).
